raw_segments.text: Gone already, inch-thick, knee-deep, o'erhead and ears a-forked one.
Go play, boy, play, thy mother plays, and I play too, but so disgracked apart, whose
issue will hiss me to my grave, contempt and clamour will be my knell.
There have been, or I am much deceived, cuckled's air now, and many a man there is even at this
present now while I speak this, holds his wife by T.H. arm, that little thing she has
been sluked in sabsence, and his pond fished by his next neighbour by Sir Smile his neighbour.
Nay, there's comfort in't, whilst other men have gates, and those gates opened as mine
Should all despair that hath revolted wives, the tenth of mankind would hang themselves.
Physic fort there's none, it is a body-planet that will strike where T's predominant,
and T's powerful think it from east, west, north and south, be it concluded no barricado
Note, it will let in and out the enemy with bag and baggage.
Many thousand of us have the disease and feel not.
